physical.title: Guided and leaked samples in a finite dielectric guide

interpretation.requestedResult: Observe guided, direct and leaked exit counts for this explicitly dimensioned native fan.
stated: A19 gives the index of a pipe in air and asks for the limiting entrance angle for total internal reflection.
derived: A rectangular meridional slice with explicit dimensions can distinguish far-end exit from side leakage.
assumptions: The drawn pipe dimensions and fan are synthetic. Use a homogeneous two-dimensional guide and omit Fresnel partial reflection.
unknowns: Source pipe dimensions, skew rays and continuous throughput.
